source_metadata.title: Venous thromboembolism chemoprophylaxis regimens in trauma and surgery patients with obesity: A systematic review
source_metadata.journal: Journal of Trauma and Acute Care Surgery

extraction_limitations: The governing LiteratureAtom model is oriented to primary literature, while this source is a systematic review. Review-level assertions were extracted directly; selected included-study findings are explicitly tagged secondary_reported_result and remain anchored to the review rather than represented as primary-study evidence.

Supplemental digital content referenced by the article was not part of the uploaded PDF. Main-text statements about supplemental risk-of-bias/GRADE analyses were captured, but supplemental tables and figures were not independently atomized.

The review reports heterogeneous anti-factor Xa targets and outcome definitions across included studies. No missing study-level details were inferred or harmonized beyond what the review itself reports.
Review-reported results were prioritized when they were used in the narrative to support the review conclusions; the atom set does not create a separate primary-study atom for every cell of Table 4.
